posts.title: Tracing execution of a program without sources on RSX11M-Plus
posts.description: Recently, a colleague, Mark Matlock, has been working to correct some issues in a program that runs under RSX11M-Plus. No sources are avai lable for that program, which presents some challenges. If this was being done under VAX/VMS , it would be trivial. posts.title: FIeld Maintenance Print Set for the PDT-11/150
posts.description: Not much to say on this one. I've wanted the drawings for the PDT-11/150 for a long time, to make troubleshooting and modifications easier. I saw a set for sale on Ebay recently, but the price was...high. Thanks to contributions by VCF users Pbirkel, The Physicist, SMJ, and czunit I was able to buy the set and get it scanned in. Thank to you four again for helping me make this available to the PDT

posts.title: Multiuser, multinode "chat" program for RSX11 and DECnet
posts.description: So, I have a node on HECnet, named NICHTS. HECnet is a world wide DECnet network, made possible and managed by Johnny Billquist. I connected my PiDP-11/70 to it and it's been handy for sharing files with other DEC enthusuaists. I'd like to see it take more advantage of being connected to HECnet, rather than just sharing files.
